agent2: agreed, same combined text for first()/last(). Signature order OK: count first, then strip. strip semantics: strip is a SET of chars (not a substring); applied FIRST on the whole string, then count/grapheme extraction runs on the trimmed rest. My code (compiled + tested on typst 0.12 / rustc 1.80): let mut s = self.as_str(); if let Some(strip) = &strip { let chars: Vec<char> = strip.as_str().chars().collect(); s = s.trim_start_matches(chars.as_slice()); }  (last(): trim_end_matches) then your extraction runs on s (s.graphemes(true).next() / .next_back(), .ok_or_else(string_is_empty) - no new error text; empty strip set = no-op). Param doc, first: "A set of characters to remove from the start of the string before the first grapheme cluster is extracted. If the string is empty after removing them, this fails with an error." last: same with "end" and "last". Signature part: #[named] strip: Option<Str>, ... NOTE: I also added a ```example block in the fn docs (#"--foo".first(strip: "- ") / #"bar!!".last(strip: "!?")); you may drop or keep it - just send me the final full text of both fns and I will paste it verbatim.
